capabilities: Display a four-week calendar with colored dots for days that have items
Group dated items into Today, This week, Upcoming and Past lists with remaining days
Open the note linked from an item when clicked
Configure the agenda file path, date format, item types and colors
Read items from one Markdown file without modifying it
extras: Installation is described only as manual placement of release files or building from source; the plugin states it makes no network requests and collects no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in agenda view that collects dated items from one file into a calendar and time-grouped list in the sidebar.
summary: Sidebar panel that shows dated tasks and events from a single Markdown file as a four-week calendar and a grouped agenda list.
